post.description: Keeps the player's run of a request: the capture file, gzipped, at most 50 MB (413 above it, as for any body). A player has one run per request. A filled request still takes a run from a player who was recording when it filled, and a closed one, or one with twice the wanted number of runs, takes none (409).

post.summary: Keeps what the player saw of items, to draw them as the game does.
Counts what the mod saw and had no handling for.

404.description: dragsim.co knows no player by that name. | The player has no profile, or none with that id.

503.description: dragsim.co did not answer, and the backend has no copy to fall back on.

get.description: A player's profile as the overview draws it: the one they play now, or the one `profile` names. The backend keeps a copy for a short while, so asking again soon does not reach dragsim.co.

404.description: The snapshot has no container with that id.

410.description: The snapshot is gone. Fetch the profile again for a new one.
